sections.value:
#281 R1 correctness review
Head: ed493731a221dc57a17811962203ee07ff925429
Base: 7ec3e176
Result: BLOCK

R281-001 (medium): the retry budget is not reset on a new thread start.
crates/daemon/src/codex_bind.rs:257-266,287-293
thread_started selects every pending row, but the old failures entry survives
when that same row fails again. After four consecutive failed probes, introduce
a new thread lock on the very next tick and let that probe encounter one Busy
read. Its counter becomes five, so the row stays Seen. Once the read recovers,
the following unchanged tick does not probe and the valid seat remains unbound.
Reset the failed-probe budget when the lockset supplies a fresh thread-start
reason, before probing; retain the three-additional-probes brake per reason.
Evidence: reviewer_new_thread_resets_an_exhausted_retry_budget_before_a_quiet_tick
fails on unchanged production code from this head: bound 0, expected 1.

R281-002 (medium): registration read errors are classified as decisions.
crates/daemon/src/codex_bind.rs:369-377
register_via distinguishes RegistrationError::Runtime from stable refusals, but
the new catch-all turns both into Ok(false). A single transient liveness read
inside registration is therefore marked Seen, and the healthy next tick never
tries registration again. Preserve the Runtime error as an Err for the existing
bounded retry path; genuine refusals should continue to log and keep Seen.
Evidence: reviewer_a_transient_registration_read_retries_on_the_next_tick fails
on unchanged production code from this head: bound 0, expected 1. The control
reviewer_registration_refusal_is_seen_and_does_not_retry passes: an observed
start mismatch remains unbound and costs exactly one probe over 30 ticks.

Passing controls and provenance:
The detached review worktree stayed clean. just pr-freeze 281 verified the exact
head, CLEAN main base, non-draft status and successful latest CI checks.
The committed codex_bind suite passed 9/9 with:
  PIJ_SHARED_TARGET="$(harness/scripts/cargo-target.sh)" just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --lib codex_bind -- --nocapture
The expanded suite used git archive of this exact SHA in a private source copy,
with only five reviewer tests and their helpers added: 12 pass, 2 fail (exit 101).
reviewer_one_busy_probe_is_retried_after_release passes: one failed pane read,
then 30 unchanged ticks bind once to the correct thread, with five mocked fact
stages total. reviewer_reused_pane_after_busy_is_not_bound_or_retried_as_an_error
passes: a different pane wrapper after the failed read does not bind; the
negative decision stops retries (four mocked stages total).
The probe patch and full local log are retained as reviewer-probes.patch and
probes.log in the review session's pr281-review evidence folder.

Requested mutations, each independently caught:
Seen-on-Err: replace seen.rows.remove(&id) with seen.rows.insert(id), leaving
the retry cap intact. just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --lib
codex_bind::tests::a_failed_pane_read_is_retried_on_the_next_tick -- --exact
--nocapture exits 101: bound 0, expected 1. Receipt: mutation-seen.log.
Retry brake: restore row removal, then change PROBE_RETRIES from 3 to 50.
just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --lib
codex_bind::tests::a_failing_probe_is_retried_three_times_then_waits_for_a_thread
-- --exact --nocapture exits 101: 100 mocked stages, expected 8.
Receipt: mutation-retry-cap.log. Both experiments used only the private source
copy and the same serialized, nice-19 shared target; neither changed this PR.

Full gate attempt:
harness checks exited 1: six sensors passed, eight failed, one attribution
advisory warned. Rust (fmt, macOS clippy and all workspace tests), route inventory,
smoke, pij-skill, native contracts and the installed Copilot SDK contract passed.
The TS-based path/config/docs/coverage/lockfile sensors lacked local tsx,
typecheck/test lacked local dependencies, and lint selected incompatible ambient
Biome because node_modules is absent. Boot had already returned NOT-READY for
that dependency state. No dependencies were installed or linked (C25); exact-head
CI remains the TS proof. These environment failures are not additional PR
findings and the local full gate is not represented as green.

Identity and cost:
Each retry freshly reads the spawn child record, child-parent relationship,
single writer-lock thread, saved conversation, current pane-wrapper PID and
child start; registration rechecks the process start and roster collisions.
Neither finding is an authorization bypass. C33's same-user boundary is kept;
the PR adds no paths, home paths, dependencies or launch sites.
The existing binder tick is the configured delivery interval (default 5 s),
serialized by TickLoop. Retry eligibility changes, not the loop. Quiet decided
rows still launch nothing. At most three additional probes per failing pending
row per reason is a brake: removing it only adds probes. Mock Facts counts
stages, not real launches: macOS Busy costs one lsof and zero tmux launches;
proc-start normally reads in-process and only its existing fallback launches ps.
The failures map retains only rows failing the current batch, rows retains only
current pending IDs, and locks replaces the current directory snapshot; no
per-thread historical map grows forever. New-thread budget reset is nevertheless
incorrect as R281-001 proves.

Harness feedback:
The existing tests cover a new thread only after 50 ticks, when the old failure
entry has already been cleared; they do not pin the immediate new-thread edge
or distinguish registration Runtime from Refused. Encode the two failing probes
alongside the fixes. magicWand: one read-only review-probe recipe that archives
a frozen SHA, serializes shared-target builds, preserves mutation receipts and
cleans only its private source copy.
